messages:
Erin: Morning — quick async standup. SLO sweep completed for eu-west cluster, small burn on p99 embed latency overnight (~0.7% above target). What I did: reran kv-cache warmup job, investigated autoscaler spikes, opened a follow-up PR. Blockers: need a second reviewer for the batching PR (#4482). Today: finish the CR, tidy runbook note for paging behavior, help oncall with a noisy alert.

Matt: Saw the p99 blip too. The spike aligns with a slow downstream redis node for ~6m starting 03:14 UTC. I rebased #4482 and left a comment about increasing the kv prefix TTL.

Kevin: Re: runbook, I'll add a short remediation step to shadow traffic to model-variant if redis is unhealthy. Draft snippet:
```
If redis latency > 200ms for 2m:
- flip routing to cached-variant
- notify oncall and open ticket
- run `scripts/kv-warmup --region eu-west`
```
Will PR in a bit.

Jules: Oncall notes — got a pager at 03:18 for high 504 rate on embed API, handled by draining one pod and restarting. No follow-on incident. Added a note to rotation doc to check autoscaler cooldown window. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Pager opened: #P-2312 (embed-api 504s) at 2026-03-12T03:18:22Z — acknowledged by Jules.

Erin: Thanks, Jules. Can someone give a quick 👍 on #4482 so I can merge and run the warmup in prod? Also want to schedule a 30m async postmortem-lite if we see this repeat.

Matt: I'll review now, quick pass done. left a question about metric labels.

Kevin: Approved. Left a minor nit about a log message.

Erin: Awesome — merging after Kevin's nit. Deploy-bot will push the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for commit a1b2c3 (service: embed-api, region: eu-west). Monitoring p50/p95/p99 and errors.

Jules: One more operational ask — can we add a dashboard sparkline for redis tail-latency to the SLO page? Helps oncall spot regressions faster. I'll draft the grafana panel and drop a link.

Erin: Yep please do. Also adding a tiny action item: update the oncall checklist to include `check redis tail-latency panel` at top.

Matt: FYI I'm blocked briefly on a infra quota request for a ded pool resize, pinged infra-ops. If that takes >4h I'll post an async update.

Kevin: Today I'll finish the runbook PR and run a couple of synthetic tests against the canary (load profile: 75% p95 traffic). Will report back.

Erin: Thanks all — tl;dr action items: (1) Merge #4482 (done), (2) Kevin to PR runbook + synthetics, (3) Jules to add grafana panel + update oncall checklist, (4) Matt to follow infra quota and update if delayed. If anyone sees the embed p99 >1% burn again ping @Erin and escalate to tier2.

Jules: noted. Night owls — stay safe, I'll keep an eye for the next 30m. :coffee:
